releases.notes:
# StabiliFPS v1.3.1

**Sodium raises your ceiling. StabiliFPS raises your floor.**

A client-side Fabric stability companion for Minecraft 26.2+. Focuses purely on making high FPS feel consistent (1% lows, frame-time variance, hitch attribution) without compromising gameplay.

## What's new in 1.3.1

### Critical Bug Fixes
- **Fixed random invisibility of mobs, items, and entities**  
  The entity culling system had a logic error that could drop entities from the render list. Rewritten the filtering logic to be correct and safe.

- **Stabilized FPS cap behavior**  
  The optional adaptive framerate cap was too aggressive and would randomly flip between your video settings and the mod config. Now uses much stricter conditions for raising the cap, respects manual changes for 30+ seconds, and defaults to less frequent adjustments.

- **New mod logo**  
  Proper icon so it no longer shows a `?` in the Minecraft mod list / Mod Menu.

### Other improvements carried from 1.3.0
- Strong "Sodium sub-pack" design: detects companions and adapts (gives more headroom when Sodium is present, etc.)
- Velocity-predictive chunk pacer + live utilization % on the HUD
- Better young-gen aware GC deferral
- Improved compatibility with other perf mods

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Java **25**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API for 26.2

**Highly recommended companions:** Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore

## Downloads
- `stabilifps-1.3.1.jar` (main)
- `stabilifps-1.3.1-sources.jar`

All features are independently toggleable. Zero-config safe out of the box (HUD + GC monitor + chunk pacer + raise-only RD governor are on).

F6 = Config | F7 = Toggle HUD | F8 = Toggle RD Governor | F9 = Toggle entire mod

---

**"If you're getting 280 FPS but it tanks to 40 every few seconds, this tries to keep it flat."**

releases.notes:
# StabiliFPS v1.3.0 — Sodium's Best Companion

**A true sub-pack / helper for Sodium and other performance mods.**

Sodium (and friends) raise your ceiling. StabiliFPS raises your floor and keeps those high frame rates *stable*.

---

## Highlights

- **Full "Sodium sub-pack" compatibility**
  - Automatic runtime detection of Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, EntityCulling, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, Iris
  - Respects and builds on top of "boosted" performance (higher RD, faster chunking, etc.)
  - Companion-aware scaling: more budget headroom when Sodium is present
  - Never fights or undoes gains from other mods

- **Major 26.2 support** (previous release)
  - Updated to Minecraft 26.2 + Fabric API 0.153.0+26.2
  - Fixed Gui/Hud reorganization (screen, chat, hideGui)

- **Smarter Chunk Pacer** (the flagship stability feature)
  - Velocity-predictive throttling (proactively paces when flying fast)
  - Live utilization % shown in HUD (`pacer normal 87%`)
  - Companion-aware budget scaling

- **Better GC handling**
  - AllocationBudget now detects actual young-gen/Eden space for more accurate deferral

- **Improved compatibility everywhere**
  - Entity culler steps aside when dedicated EntityCulling mod is present
  - All governors are more tolerant in boosted environments
  - Stronger "never lower your settings" guarantees

---

## All Changes (v1.2.0 → v1.3.0)

### Compatibility & Companion Mode
- New `ModCompat` system for detecting and adapting to other mods
- Logs and HUD now show companion badges (`+Sodium`)
- Chunk pacer, RD governor, and FPS governor adjust behavior when Sodium etc. are present
- Updated fabric.mod.json description and README to emphasize "Sodium sub-pack"

### Stability Improvements
- Velocity-based predictive chunk load pacing
- Pacer utilization now visible in both compact and full HUD
- More precise young-gen memory tracking for GC-aware deferral
- Entity culler compatibility improvements

### 26.2 Port (carried forward)
- Full port from 26.1 → 26.2
- `mc.gui.setScreen`, `mc.gui.hud.getChat()`, `mc.gui.hud.isHidden()` fixes
- Updated to latest Fabric API

### Other
- Version bumped to 1.3.0
- Various doc and logging polish
- All changes remain zero-config safe, toggleable, raise-only where relevant, and use `require = 0` mixins

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API **0.153.0+26.2**
- Java **25**

**Strongly recommended:** Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore

---

## Downloads

- `stabilifps-1.3.0.jar` — main mod
- `stabilifps-1.3.0-sources.jar` — sources

---

mods.name: StabiliFPS
mods.description: Sodium raises your ceiling, StabiliFPS raises your floor. A client-side Fabric mod focused purely on frame-time STABILITY — not average FPS. It kills the sudden 100 -> 8 -> 100 stutter by pacing chunk-mesh bursts across frames, deferring allocating work before GC pauses, and measuring the metrics that actually matter (1% low, 0.1% low, variance) on a live HUD that tells you WHY each frame dropped (chunk / gc / entity). Designed to never compromise gameplay: the render-distance governor only ever RAISES render distance (never lowers yours), and every gameplay-affecting feature is off by default or strictly additive. Composes with every other perf mod; every feature is independently toggleable. Zero-config safe out of the box.

releases.notes:
## Philosophy shift: measure honestly, intervene surgically, never compromise gameplay

Your render distance is now a **hard floor**. v1.0 could lower it (causing the very chunk-flash stutter it existed to fix); v1.1 has **no code path that lowers your render distance**.

### New
- **Chunk-load pacer** — the headline feature. Spreads chunk-mesh upload bursts across frames against an adaptive µs budget. This is the #1 documented cause of Minecraft stutter ([Mojang MC-166005](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-166005)) and no existing mod paces it. Boosts during initial world load, throttles when frame time degrades.
- **Render-distance governor** (replaces adaptive RD) — only ever *raises* RD toward your max when healthy; never lowers it. On degradation it freezes growth and tells you.
- **GC-aware allocation deferral** — defers non-critical allocating work by one frame when a GC pause is imminent.
- **Honest HUD** — now shows **why** each frame dropped: `chunk` / `gc` / `entity`. New documented stability score (1% low 40%, variance 25%, 0.1% low 20%, headroom 15%).

### Zero-config safe defaults
Install it and immediately get smoother frames: HUD on, GC monitor on, RD governor on (raise-only), chunk pacer on, GC-deferral on. Adaptive cap **off**, entity cull **off**. New **Reset to recommended** button in the config screen.

### Hardening
- FrameTimeTracker: no per-frame allocations (reusable scratch buffer), per-frame stat cache, hitch-cause attribution.
- JUnit 5 regression suite over the stats engine.
- All mixins `require=0`: future MC refactors no-op a feature, never crash.

## Downloads
- `stabilifps-1.1.0.jar` — the mod (drop into your mods folder)
- `stabilifps-1.1.0-sources.jar` — sources

**Delete your `config/stabilifps.json` once** so the new zero-config defaults take effect (it regenerates).

mods.name: StabiliFPS
mods.description: Sodium's best companion. StabiliFPS takes the high average FPS that Sodium/Lithium give you and makes it STABLE — killing the sudden 100 -> 8 -> 100 stutter by adapting render distance, framerate cap and entity culling to the live frame budget. Includes a live HUD (1% lows, frame-time sparkline, GC pauses) and a built-in A/B benchmark harness that exports reproducible reports. Designed to compose with every other perf mod; every feature is independently toggleable.

releases.notes:
Initial release of StabiliFPS — a frame-time stabiliser mod for Minecraft Java Edition 26.1+ (Fabric).

Built and verified against Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.152.1+26.1.2.

## Downloads
- `stabilifps-1.0.0.jar` — the mod (drop into your mods folder)
- `stabilifps-1.0.0-sources.jar` — sources

## What's fixed in this build
- **Chunk-flash feedback loop fixed**: the adaptive render distance / framerate cap subsystems were triggering Minecraft's chunk reload, whose spike fed back as 'degradation' and forced another reload. Measurement is now frozen for 4s (RD) / 2s (cap) after any change.
- **F6 config screen now scrolls** with the mouse wheel when content overflows the viewport; title and Done button are pinned.
